ata.title: Forward Fuselage Wiring — Avionics Bay Harnesses

abstract: Wiring diagram sheet for the avionics bay harnesses, showing the rack column feeds, the splice module positions and the ground point arrangement along the bay side walls.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the avionics bay harnesses, the rack column feeds, the splice modules and the ground points, for all ZEPHYR-22 family aircraft.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn looking aft with the bay floor removed. Rack column feeds are shown by column and not by unit, because the unit population changes with the avionics standard; the column feed capacity given on the sheet is the limit that governs whether a new unit can be added to a column. Splice module positions are fixed by structure and cannot be moved. The ground point arrangement on sheet 2 is common to all avionics standards and its bonding resistance limits apply whatever unit is fitted.
sections.routing_note: The harnesses enter the bay at the forward pressure bulkhead penetration and run aft along both side walls through zones 123 and 145 to the rack columns, with a cross-bay tie at the centre station. Antenna feeders are routed on the opposite side wall from the power feeds and the separation is stated on the sheet. Any harness disturbed at a rack column must be re-secured at the original support station and not simply tied to a neighbouring bundle.
